latest.title: Strive buys 1,800 Bitcoin for $143M, becomes fifth-biggest corporate holder

latest.title: Tom Lee's Bitmine Buys $131M of ETH in Largest Ethereum Purchase Since June
latest.description: The purchase lifts Bitmine's stash to 5.9 million ETH—4.9% of supply—as chairman Tom Lee points to crypto's strong third quarter.

latest.title: Russian crypto trading to bring $46B to regulated exchanges in first year after legalization: Report
latest.description: Regulated cryptocurrency exchanges may see more than $46 billion in crypto trading volume during the first year after legalization, according to estimates from the country’s largest bank.

latest.title: NYSE owner ICE taps tZERO for tokenized securities push, takes stake in firm
latest.description: The deal adds transfer-agent and settlement infrastructure to ICE's plans for an NYSE-affiliated market for tokenized stocks, tZERO said.

latest.title: The 'choose your own adventure' earnings: Why retailers are handling tariff refunds so differently
latest.description: Retailers have diverged on how they've reported tariff refunds in their earnings this quarter, with some choosing to lower prices and others boosting margins.

latest.title: OpenAI's ad business shows blistering growth, hits $1 billion annualized revenue run rate
latest.description: OpenAI's move to serve ads in ChatGPT earlier this year drew ridicule from its chief rival, Anthropic, in the form of a Super Bowl commercial.

latest.title: South Korea Will Give Every Citizen Free AI Access With Unlimited Tokens
latest.description: Three consortia will run the service, sharing up to 512 Nvidia B200 chips supplied by the state, with beta testing due in September.

latest.title: Ireland bars crypto from new tax-advantaged investment accounts
latest.description: Eligible assets for the new accounts include listed stocks, bonds, and ETFs, with providers handling tax reporting to simplify investor compliance.

latest.title: Japanese regulator requests tax filing exemption for trust-type stablecoins in 2027 reform
latest.description: Japan’s FSA requested to exempt trust-type stablecoins from mandatory tax filings starting in fiscal year 2027, arguing that it would improve their use as transaction tools.
